1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with a light-activated microtransponder (MTP) affixed thereto, wherein the MTP is __capable of being activated and read through the test tube material__.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube __such that the MTP remains functional and readable after embedding__.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the __bottom surface of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards through the test tube material__.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube __designed for long-term storage of biological samples at cryogenic temperatures__.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __in a manner that preserves the light-activation and reading capability of the MTP__.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.

(Currently Amended) A system for storing samples comprising the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes __configured for automated handling__; __an__ automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes __in a coordinated manner__; and __an__ automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes __while maintaining sample integrity__.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 __wherein the system is__ adapted for low temperature operation, such that the racks/test tubes are handled at -20°C or less __and the MTP remains functional at such temperatures__.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising __heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP such that the MTP is embedded within the plastic material__.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing __a test tube assembly with an__ embedded MTP; and reading the MTP __by directing light through the test tube material to activate the MTP__.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __in a manner that preserves the light-activation and reading capability of the MTP__.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.
